Description.Name: Solaris 7 Battle Royale: Assault Mech

Quicsell is not liable for any injury or multiple injuries including death caused by this event. This item immediately generates a Battle Royal contract on the planet of purchase. Do not sell this item from your inventory, bad things will happen.
